title: Journey groups drawer
description: Group organization and assignment for journeys.

ui.overview: The Journey groups drawer is used to organize journeys into collections. It helps when a project contains more than one route story and you need a predictable way to keep them sorted.

controls.label: Group selector
controls.description: Chooses the active group for the current journey.

controls.label: Assignment controls
controls.description: Moves or assigns journeys between groups.

controls.label: Sort order
controls.description: Changes how journeys are ordered inside the list.

controls.label: Add group
controls.description: Opens the group creation form with fields for a name, color, parent, and description.

controls.label: Add journey
controls.description: Opens the journey picker so you can add journeys to the current group.

controls.label: Group name, color, parent, description
controls.description: Defines a group's identity and hierarchy. The parent can be set to No parent.

controls.label: Edit / remove group
controls.description: Edits the group details or removes the group from the tree after confirmation.

controls.label: Expand / collapse tree
controls.description: Expands or collapses groups while you browse their contents.

steps.title: Create a group
steps.description: Select Add group, complete the fields, then confirm with Create group.

steps.title: Add journeys
steps.description: Select a group, choose Add journey, select the journeys, and confirm the selection.

steps.title: Organize the tree
steps.description: Change the parent, reorder items, and use the edit or remove action on the appropriate group.

notes: Use groups when a project contains multiple journeys that need a stable editorial order.
This drawer is for organization, not for route geometry editing.
